what: End-to-end check of the Kong gateway: real Kong 3.12 in front of the real Anthropic API. Watchdog's full pipeline on 6 stored listings, plus kong_demo.py and one smoke test (docs/kong.md, 'End-to-end check').
kong: kong/kong-gateway:3.12 (3.12.0.12) + watchdog-audit, ai-proxy route_type preserve, upstream https://api.anthropic.com
commands: make kong   (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Kong's environment only)
cd backend && uv run python -m deadlang.eval.run_eval --full --stratified 6 --max-usd 3 --run-id kongreal6 --yes

result.non_200: 1 (the demo's injection listing, blocked by ai-prompt-guard, 400 from Kong)
result.audit_chain: verified: 83 entries; calls by role agents 49, examiner 24, translation 1, triage 9; blocked 1
result.calls_breakdown: 80 eval (6 triage, 1 translation, 24 examiner, 49 agents) + 2 kong_demo.py (1 passed, 1 blocked) + 1 smoke test
result.listings_note: All 6 sampled listings were true positives (the sampler takes positives first): a plumbing check, not an accuracy result.

tokens_eval_run.note: Kong's token metrics leave out prompt-cache reads and writes, so a cost built from them is about 7% low here.

latency.note: Overhead from Prometheus histogram buckets (upper bounds), real traffic. Model time is the mean per call.
